statement: For the plus Fermat cubic and its full rank-ten pro3 geometric group N, the abelian section class alpha=alpha_P+27 kappa3(19)e_B0 has minimum toric coordinates (2,19^27) and a nonempty full intrinsic class-two fiber, equal to the explicit torsor of E.37. Every class-two section in that fiber fails to lift to N/gamma4N, to N/N'', or to the intrinsic marked-depth quotient N/gamma3I. A Galois-equivariant finite class-three quotient of order3^30 gives an explicit obstruction at19, with the modular annihilating row (1,660,558,162) modulo729.

notes: The positive full-class2 lift uses the exact local44x44 cokernel exponents27 at both primes over19, triviality of kappa19 at2, and finite support. The actual quotient F/[I_y,I_y] has multiplication (a,v)(b,w)=(a+b,v+T^a w), and its Galois action is (chi a,chi v(T^chi)) because the normalized conjugator lies in F' and the I_y-image is abelian. The cubic image is H=3Z3 semidirect (3,U)Z3[[U]]. The tangent and origin change are typed. The necessary tame equation T^3v(T^19)=v with augmentation81 has no integral solution. The finite certificate continues to hold modulo gamma4(H_6), so it detects intrinsic class3 rather than only an unspecified higher quotient. All coefficients and the full modular solution lattice are computed, and a direct integer row independently certifies the negative result. This is a proved additional obstruction, not a complete metabelian or marked-depth section classification.
